patch_description:
This implementation replaces full-layout differential evolution with a canonicalized, constraint-focused evolutionary search. Movable points are sorted in simplex-coordinate order after every mutation, making pointwise elite recombination meaningful despite the points being geometrically unlabeled.

The search combines three complementary mechanisms: rank-based elite ancestry, conservative pointwise recombination between compatible elite layouts, and active-constraint repair moves that preferentially mutate points participating in currently smallest triangles. A final deterministic/randomized maximin polish focuses exclusively on improving the weakest triangle constraints. This uses substantially smaller vectorized populations than the original program while spending more evaluations on structurally useful candidates.
